title: 2022 年 6 月英语六级真题（第 2 套）

analysis.topic: 南京长江大桥的建设意义
analysis.reference: Nanjing Yangtze River Bridge is the first rail-road dual-use bridge over the Yangtze River that was designed by China and built with domestic materials. The upper deck is a four-lane highway bridge with a length of 4,589 meters, while the lower deck is a double-track railway bridge stretching 6,772 meters. The railway bridge connects the former Tianjin-Pukou and Shanghai-Nanjing railway lines, reducing the time for trains to cross the river from one and a half hours to a mere two minutes. The bridge serves as a vital transportation hub linking the north and the south, and is also one of the famous attractions in Nanjing. The completion of the Nanjing Yangtze River Bridge marked a great leap in China's bridge construction, greatly facilitating the exchange of goods and flow of people between the two banks of the Yangtze River, and playing a tremendous role in promoting economic development and improving people's livelihood.

sentences.cn: 南京长江大桥是长江上首座由中国设计、采用国产材料建造的铁路、公路两用桥，
sentences.en: Nanjing Yangtze River Bridge is the first rail-road dual-use bridge over the Yangtze River that was designed by China and built with domestic materials.
sentences.structure: 主系表结构 + that 引导的定语从句修饰 bridge，从句内含并列被动语态 was designed... and built...
keys: 铁路、公路两用桥 rail-road dual-use bridge
由中国设计 designed by China

sentences.cn: 上层的4车道公路桥长4589米，下层的双轨道铁路桥长6772米。
sentences.en: The upper deck is a four-lane highway bridge with a length of 4,589 meters, while the lower deck is a double-track railway bridge stretching 6,772 meters.
sentences.structure: while 连接的并列句，前后形成上层与下层的对比结构；用 with a length of 和现在分词 stretching 交替表达长度以避免重复
keys: 双轨道铁路桥 double-track railway bridge

sentences.cn: 铁路桥连接原来的天津一浦口和上海―南京两条铁路线，使火车过江从过去一个半小时缩短为现在的2分钟。
sentences.en: The railway bridge connects the former Tianjin-Pukou and Shanghai-Nanjing railway lines, reducing the time for trains to cross the river from one and a half hours to a mere two minutes.
sentences.structure: 主句 + 现在分词短语 reducing... 作结果状语；from... to... 结构表示时间缩短
keys: 天津-浦口铁路线 Tianjin-Pukou railway line
上海-南京铁路线 Shanghai-Nanjing railway line

sentences.cn: 大桥是南北交通的重要枢纽，也是南京的著名景点之一。
sentences.en: The bridge serves as a vital transportation hub linking the north and the south, and is also one of the famous attractions in Nanjing.
sentences.structure: serves as... and is also... 并列谓语结构；linking... 现在分词作后置定语修饰 hub
keys: 著名景点之一 one of the famous attractions

sentences.cn: 南京长江大桥的建成标志着中国桥梁建设的一个飞跃，大大方便了长江两岸的物资交流和人员来往，对促进经济发展和改善人民生活起到了巨大作用。
sentences.en: The completion of the Nanjing Yangtze River Bridge marked a great leap in China's bridge construction, greatly facilitating the exchange of goods and flow of people between the two banks of the Yangtze River, and playing a tremendous role in promoting economic development and improving people's livelihood.
sentences.structure: 主句 marked... + 两个并列现在分词短语 facilitating... and playing... 作伴随状语；play a role in doing 固定搭配嵌套并列动名词
keys: 物资交流 exchange of goods
人员来往 flow of people
起到巨大作用 play a tremendous role

pitfalls: 「首座」漏译或误译为 a first，应为 the first 加定冠词表唯一性
「铁路、公路两用桥」译为 bridge for railway and road 不够专业，应用 dual-use bridge
「使火车过江从…缩短为…」句式复杂，容易漏掉 reducing 的逻辑主语或 from...to... 搭配
「飞跃」误译为 fly 或 jump，应为 a great leap 表示重大进步
「对…起到巨大作用」中 play a role in 后须接动名词，常见错误为接不定式

upgrades.plain: is a very important transportation center
upgrades.better: serves as a vital transportation hub
upgrades.note: serve as 比 is 更正式地道，hub 比 center 更契合交通枢纽语境

upgrades.plain: made the time shorter from one and a half hours to two minutes
upgrades.better: reducing the time from one and a half hours to a mere two minutes
upgrades.note: 现在分词作状语更简洁，a mere 强调时间之短，表达更精炼

upgrades.plain: had a great effect on promoting economic development
upgrades.better: played a tremendous role in promoting economic development
upgrades.note: play a role in 是固定高分搭配，tremendous 比 great 更具书面语色彩

upgrades.plain: made it very convenient for goods exchange and people communication
upgrades.better: greatly facilitating the exchange of goods and flow of people
upgrades.note: 分词结构避免多个简单句堆砌，facilitate 比 make convenient 更学术

upgrades.plain: was a big improvement in bridge building
upgrades.better: marked a great leap in bridge construction
upgrades.note: marked a leap 更具里程碑意味，construction 比 building 更正式专业
